race_root_cause: Prior Q4-S pricing automation used waitForSelector(...).catch(()=>{}) which swallowed load timeouts, then clicked stage CTA / screenshot while the Builder was still on the Hebrew loading spinner (טוען). Also reused WEB_URL=127.0.0.1 while Vite listens on IPv6 localhost. This is a QA navigation/wait bug, not a Builder stage initialization race.

checks.mobile_margin_note: On ≤768px desktop summary rail is collapsed; authorized margin appears in mobile dock and רווחיות tab. Confirmed visually on 390-dark-bottom (dock) and 1440-dark-profitability.
